record.title: Reduce sealed RF records and quantify comparison limits
record.intent: Turn retained measurements into reproducible relative and, where supported, absolute response estimates.
requirements: Work offline from sealed records using the frozen estimator and normalization. Exercise known-amplitude synthetic records and malformed/incomplete controls before interpreting physical results.

Check scaling/preambles, actual sampling, completeness and decimation; retain fit residuals, repeat dispersion and baseline-return drift. Missing arms remain missing rather than being inferred from expected behavior.

Separate relative policy effects from corrected absolute response; quantify supported uncertainty and unresolved source/spectral/loading effects. An uncharacterized chain cannot establish calibrated absolute bandwidth.

Produce reproducible tables/plots with explicit scope and data exclusions, keeping unit identifiers and raw private evidence out of source. Reuse the typed workspace conventions for any necessary Python implementation.
acceptance: Reproducible reduction supports scoped response estimates or an explicit finding that the retained data cannot answer the declared question.

review.rationale: Review updated acquisition head upstream first. The current stock readiness and isolated control remedy alter provenance/controller binding only. The committed estimator and numerical contract remain applicable without rerunning already-established controls. Reduction remains unexecuted until actual sealed RF inputs exist.

evidence.estimator_controls: Reuse existing accepted numerical/verifier controls and V5 completed-arm verification; no estimator/source/electrical/75-slot changes or broad rerun. New23 controls validate readiness evidence only, not RF estimates.
evidence.reduction: No accepted RF comparison records yet; no synthetic or native-policy samples become waveform inputs. Future reduction must bind accepted actual A1/B/A2 completed-arm seals and all75 unique slots.
evidence.uncertainty: Source/cable/level/spectral uncertainty persists. Keep unwindowed demeaned population AC RMS, fixed return-control0.3dB and all primary pair1dB criteria; no fitting,anchor correction,extra points or outcome-driven repeats.
evidence.limitations: New actual stock17/17/currentUI/warmup validates readiness only. Cache incident preserves all845originals and complete847 derivative, not altered waveform semantics. Missing/ineligible measurements remain unassessable; no calibrated analog bandwidth or fundamental amplitude is inferred.
